breakdowns.description: Enables adding new users, updating user email addresses, deactivating user accounts, and maintaining a collection of users. Ensures user data can be modified while enforcing validation rules.
conditions: Usernames must be unique (no duplicates allowed)
User age must be within the range 0-150

breakdowns.description: Provides statistical analysis of users, including calculating the average age of active users and categorizing users into age groups (youth, adult, senior). Statistics are based on active users only.
conditions: Average age and age group categorization apply only to active users
